# AJAX / Fetch Expert

- Handle network errors and HTTP error status codes separately.
- Set correct content types.
- Include anti-forgery tokens when required.
- Abort stale requests when useful.
- Avoid duplicate submissions.
- Display actionable errors.
- Do not trust successful HTTP transport as proof that the business operation succeeded.
